title: Cylindrical body
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first face of the cylindrical body by creating two concentric circles. The first circle has a center at coordinates (0.0278, 0.0278) and a radius of 0.0278. The second circle, which forms the inner boundary, has the same center but a smaller radius of 0.0236. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0556 to achieve the desired dimensions. Since no additional transformations are required, proceed to extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the direction of the normal. Ensure that the extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the cylindrical body are length 0.05555555555555555, width 0.05555555555555555, and height 0.75.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the pen
r = r.center(0.0278, 0.0278) \
     .circle(0.0278) \
     .circle(0.0236) \
     .extrude(0.75, both=False)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · best of 8
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radius of the circles
center = (0.0278, 0.0278)
radius_outer = 0.0278
radius_inner = 0.0236

# Create the outer circle
r = r.center(center[0], center[1]).circle(radius_outer)

# Create the inner circle (for the hole)
r = r.circle(radius_inner)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0278, 0.0278)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0278)  # Outer circle
    .circle(0.0236)  # Inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

OD = 0.0556
H = 0.7500
ID = 0.0370

outer = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(OD / 2.0).extrude(H)
inner = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(ID / 2.0).extrude(H + 0.002).translate((0, 0, -0.001))

r = outer.cut(inner)
